{"id":1814434634,"question_id":3616,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"8 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1761683652,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1814434634/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Make Array Elements Equal to Zero","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int countValidSelections(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        int ans = 0;\n        vector<int>prefix(n+1);\n        vector<int>suffix(n+1);\n\n        for(int i=0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            prefix[i+1] = prefix[i] + nums[i];\n        }\n        \n        for(int i=n-1 ; i>=0 ; i--)\n        {\n            suffix[i] = suffix[i+1] + nums[i];\n        }\n\n        for(int i=1 ; i<n-1 ; i++)\n        {\n            if(nums[i] == 0 and prefix[i] == suffix[i+1]) ans++;\n        }        \n        return ans*2;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"make-array-elements-equal-to-zero","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1005}
